old_caption: The video depicts a dance studio setting where a person is practicing a dance routine. The individual, dressed in a green crop top and black leggings, is positioned in front of a large mirror that spans the wall. The studio features light-colored wooden flooring and teal curtains that frame the windows on either side. A ballet barre is visible along the left side of the room, and a fan is placed near the right corner. The person is seen holding a static bent-over posture with both hands on the floor. The camera remains stationary throughout the sequence, capturing the person's posture as they make slight adjustments to their position.
original_wisa_caption: The video depicts a dance studio setting where a person is practicing a dance routine. The individual, dressed in a green crop top and black leggings, is positioned in front of a large mirror that spans the wall. The studio features light-colored wooden flooring and teal curtains that frame the windows on either side. A ballet barre is visible along the left side of the room, and a fan is placed near the right corner. The person is seen bending forward, reaching towards the floor with one hand while the other arm is extended upwards, suggesting a warm-up or stretching exercise. The camera remains stationary throughout the sequence, capturing the fluid motion and posture of the dancer as they move gracefully in front of the mirror.
caption: The video depicts a dance studio with pale wood flooring, a mirror wall on the left, draped teal curtains, a ballet barre, plants, a standing fan, two lighting stands, and a wall logo. A barefoot woman in an olive tank top and black pants crouches right of center, bent forward with her right arm extended down, fingertips near the floor, and her left arm tucked behind her back. She sustains this posture throughout the clip, making only small adjustments as her torso and reaching hand shift slightly relative to the ground. The camera gradually reframes the view, widening the visible floor and repositioning the curtains, fan, stands, and logo. Her mirrored reflection tracks the same pose, moving within the glass only as the viewpoint changes. Soft shadows pool beneath her hand and feet.
